title: An offcut beyond a trim cut that touches the panel boundary, with a wheel on it
rationale: A diagonal through trim runs from the bottom edge to the right edge, cutting off the bottom-right corner; it is cut except a 57 mm bridge (40 mm along x and along y), which this program closes at C = 160. The offcut touches the panel boundary, so a test for 'islands that do not touch the boundary' misses it (E-B8); it is not the anchor's component, so the left wheel standing on it is M-ATTACH (safety-model 7.4).
